purpose: One bounded two-arm comparison on all90 consumed native inputs; no fresh data, default changes or hyperparameter search.
inputs: RMVPE stem pitch/salience, CPJKU original-mixture activity, canonical Demucs-CREPE diagnostics. Retained native arrays and exact rendered-input hashes; no model inference rerun.

targets.fit: F0 reference>0 is pitched voicing; F0=0 is unpitched, not absence of a vocal event; unknown excluded.
targets.activity: Frozen external evidence only. No vocal-presence target learned from F0-zero.
targets.phonetics: Never gated on pitched voicing or this model.

admissibility: Available native RMVPE candidate within real input bounds, finite and50-1000Hz; no salience.03 floor. Missing canonical/activity evidence has a separate indicator and imputed0 continuous features.
features: Salience/activity/confidence logits clip1e-4..1-1e-4; log RMS floor1e-6; log source share floor1e-8; absolute candidate disagreement in octaves capped2; missing flags. Nearest canonical tolerance.005001s, activity1/140+1e-8s.
fit: Fixed ridge logistic BCE; train-only weighted mean/std; constant feature scale1; unpenalized intercept; no Platt calibration, temporal decoder or regularization search. L-BFGS-B maxiter500,ftol1e-12,gtol1e-8; require finite convergence.
weights: each singer mass1, equal excerpts then 3 singing conditions; each negative family mass1, equal unique rendered inputs, repeated copies split input mass; within stream normalize mapped admissible annotation counts; omit streams with zero admissible labels; no class balancing; normalize total mass
purge: at every fit/calibration/selector level exclude held singers, exact rendered audio hashes, and negative families of validation rows; inherit all ancestor exclusions. Backing family=(recording SHA,window start); silence one family across lengths. Family purge applies to negative rows, not all singing mixtures using same backing.

cross_validation.inner_assignment: remaining numeric singers sorted then round-robin
cross_validation.nesting: Outer training -> three-fold singer-OOF scores for threshold choice -> refit on allowed outer training -> score held outer rows once. Every fit inherits ancestor singer/audio/family exclusions; weighting/standardization after purge. Same three-fold procedure on all consumed data produces final development candidate.

threshold_selection: Exact attainable states with strict greater-than after1e-12 clipping, inherited v8 selector; original gates by historical group. Rank max minimum RPA, min maximum singing FA, largest threshold. No eligible state: diagnostic threshold.5 and explicit ineligible status. No search expansion.
selection_structural_absence: Only inner selector gates for backing/silence with zero eligible validation rows after ancestor family purge are marked not_tested:ancestor_family_purge and omitted, never counted as passed. Any present control rows must satisfy original gate. Undefined metrics or missing artifacts fail. OuterOOF must include all90 rows/all5conditions/3groups.
advancement: Every outer selector eligible, complete90-case outer scores pass all unchanged historical-group gates, final selector eligible, and unchanged inherited RMVPE analytic controls complete and within50c. Inherited tone100 missingness prevents overall advancement; report empirical component separately.
probability_diagnostic: Brier over all known reference frames; unavailable/inadmissible/unmatched score0 and explicit coverage. Baseline salience is not a probability; fitted score describes benchmark weighting, not demonstrated population calibration.
stop_rule: Report both fixed arms and all failures; one run only; no fresh evaluation or automatic adoption.
limitations: Previously examined Vocadito is adaptive development evidence.
No global song IDs in preserved Vocadito metadata; singer folds do not prove song disjointness.
Only two consumed accompaniment recordings; negative-family purge is not accompaniment-disjoint mixture validation.
Exact RVC checkpoint training corpus unknown; no training-disjoint qualification claim.
